description:
Maintainer, 2026-08-12: 'for the fhr_sim_v2, i want the steam generator never to have temperature cross, it is superbly annoying'.

A TEMPERATURE CROSS IS THERMODYNAMICALLY IMPOSSIBLE, so this is a physics defect and not a display nuisance. In a counter-flow exchanger the cold stream may approach the hot stream's inlet temperature but can never exceed the local hot-stream temperature — heat would have to flow up a temperature gradient. If the simulator shows steam leaving hotter than the salt heating it, the model has violated the second law and any duty it reports is meaningless.

WHERE TO LOOK: crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/examples/fhr_sim_v2/app/thermal_hydraulics_backend/secondary_loop/ and the steam-generator duty path. Note (recorded during the 2026-08-06 audit) that the SG duty in fhr_sim_v2 is a USER-SLIDER UA — 'user_specified_secondary_loop_ua_watt_per_kelvin' — rather than a computed exchanger. An unconstrained UA slider is the most likely mechanism: drive UA high enough and a lumped model will happily transfer more heat than the pinch allows.

LIKELY FIXES, in order of honesty:
  1. Clamp the transferred duty to the thermodynamic maximum, Q_max = C_min * (T_hot_in - T_cold_in), i.e. an effectiveness-NTU formulation where effectiveness cannot exceed 1. This makes the cross impossible BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by post-hoc correction.
  2. If a lumped mean-temperature-difference form is kept, enforce a minimum pinch and clamp UA to whatever satisfies it.
  3. Do NOT simply clamp the DISPLAYED temperature — that hides the violation while leaving the reported duty wrong.

ACCEPTANCE: a test that sweeps the UA slider (and mass flows) across its full range and asserts the second law holds at every point — steam outlet never exceeds salt inlet, salt outlet never falls below feedwater inlet, and effectiveness stays within [0, 1]. That test is the deliverable as much as the fix, because it is what stops the defect returning.

Applies to fhr_sim_v2. Check whether htgr_sim_v1's secondary loop shares the mechanism.
title: fhr_sim_v2 steam generator: temperature cross must be impossible
